shapes.name: title
shapes.text: Define what a score means

shapes.name: intro
shapes.text: Lower is preferred on both scales. Weights: 60% setup, 40% components.

shapes.name: formula
shapes.text: Utility = 100 × (worst − input) ÷ (worst − best); clamp to 0–100.

shapes.name: note
shapes.text: Weighted score = sum(weight × utility). A missing preference value withholds the complete score; do not reweight the known fields.

shapes.name: source
shapes.text: Scales and priorities are assumptions for this exercise, not validated measures of user value.
